parsed.draft_response:
Hi there—sorry for the trouble. Since other users can log in normally, it sounds like an access issue specific to the newly invited analyst.

To help us get this investigated and resolved as quickly as possible, could you please reply with:
1) The analyst’s email/username that was used for the invite
2) The workspace name (or environment) she’s trying to access
3) The exact wording of the “access denied” message (you can paste the full text or share a screenshot)
4) The time she accepted the invite (approx.) and whether any workspace permission settings were changed around then

Once we have those details, we’ll escalate to our support team to review the invite and her workspace permissions and restore access.
